title: Custom fields
description: Add fields to records without a migration. They are validated on every write, shown in lists and forms, and exported.
subject: Records
none: No custom fields yet for these records.
orderHint: Drag the handle to reorder, or focus it and press Space, then the arrow keys. The move buttons do the same.
deactivateDescription: The field is no longer accepted, shown or exported. The values records already hold are kept under the key “{{key}}”, and the key is never reused. You can reactivate the field later.
inactiveHint: Their values are kept and shown again when you reactivate them.

form.description: The key is the name of the value in the data and never changes. Everything else can be edited.
form.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (for example region).
form.keyInvalid: Start with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or _ (50 at most).
form.label: Label
form.typeHint: A type can change only while no record holds a value, or when every value survives (text to long text, email or web address to text).
form.optionsHint: Each choice has a value stored with the record and a label people see.
form.optionIncomplete: Every choice needs a value and a label.
form.optionDuplicate: Two choices have the same value.
form.optionComma: A value in a multiple choice cannot contain a comma.
form.defaultHint: Filled in when a record is created without a value.
form.filterableHint: Lists can filter by this field.
form.sortableHint: Lists can sort by this field.
form.limitLength: Enter a whole number (1 or more).
form.limitOrder: The lowest must not exceed the highest.
form.patternHint: A regular expression the whole value must match (RE2: no lookaround, no backreferences). Optional.

noSubjects: No records take custom fields yet.
